name: Wide-Angle Context Camera
description: Multispectral optical imager capturing broad terrain context, dust plumes, and planetary limb profiles.
compatibilityRequirements: Requires stable 3-axis attitude control and at least 2.5 Mbps downlink.

name: High-Resolution Narrow-Angle Camera
description: Sub-meter orbital reconnaissance telescope capable of identifying boulder hazards, vent fissures, and cryovolcanism.
compatibilityRequirements: Requires high-capacity downlink (Ka-band) to prevent onboard storage bottlenecks.

name: Imaging Infrared & Raman Spectrometer
description: Analyzes absorption bands to determine surface mineralogy, ice purity, organics, and atmospheric gas fractions.
compatibilityRequirements: Requires cryogenic cooling or thermal radiator orientation away from Sun.

name: Ice-Penetrating Radar Sounder
description: Transmits high-power radar pulses to detect subsurface oceans, subsurface aquifers, and ice sheet layering down to 30 km.
compatibilityRequirements: Requires large deployable dipole antennas and substantial pulse power from battery grid.

name: Fluxgate Vector Magnetometer (Boom-Mounted)
description: Measures magnetic field perturbations to confirm induced magnetic fields from subsurface conductive saltwater oceans.
compatibilityRequirements: Requires deployable isolation boom to avoid spacecraft electromagnetic interference.

name: Thermal Emission Radiometer
description: Maps surface thermal inertia, geothermal hotspots, and nighttime temperature gradients.
compatibilityRequirements: Calibrated temperature sensor array; sensitive to direct solar reflection.

name: Passive Micro-Seismic Package
description: Ultra-sensitive inertial seismometer to measure tidal flexing, ice-quakes, and meteorite impact resonances.
compatibilityRequirements: Best deployed on lander or during close gravitational periapsis passes.

name: Geodetic Pulsed Laser Altimeter (LIDAR)
description: Measures precise topographic elevation and tidal bulge amplitudes with 5 cm vertical accuracy.
compatibilityRequirements: Requires clear line of sight to nadir and power delivery buffer for diode laser pulse bursts.
